summary: Frontend-only RETEST of the iteration_7 fixes (backend intentionally not re-run). ALL THREE requested areas PASS. (1) CRITICAL UPI QR fix confirmed: distributor login -> add-cart-ANJ-STARTER -> /app/cart -> cart-checkout-btn -> /app/checkout -> upi-pay-btn now renders upi-qr-panel on /app/checkout (URL no longer bounces to /app/products), with phonepe-qr image loaded and visible, correct amount 'Pay Rs1,575 for order ORD000025', the 'admin will verify' instruction, a success toast 'Order ORD000025 placed - scan the QR to pay', and upi-done-btn navigating to /app/orders. ZERO console errors and NO 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component' warning -> the useEffect redirect fix is correct. (2) Admin confirm E2E: /admin-secure-login rejected a wrong passcode (stayed on page, toast 'Invalid admin credentials or passcode.'), then correct email+password+passcode redirected to /admin; /admin/orders showed upi-confirm-ORD000025, clicking it flipped the row to payment=paid, status=processing, invoice INV000014 and the confirm button disappeared after reload. (3) DARK MODE contrast measured programmatically (computed color vs resolved ancestor background, WCAG ratio): Add to Cart 9.93:1 (white on #0b4d2e), cart Checkout CTA 9.93:1, Place Order & Pay 9.93:1, UPI outline btn 6.53:1, GREEN ID StatusBadge 7.67:1, 'Your distributor account is active.' banner 5.92:1 (was 2.27:1), wallet debit '-Rs500' rgb(242,138,138) on rgb(22,33,28) ~7.3:1 (was 2.94:1) - all now pass WCAG AA. Theme toggle: dark->light->reload persists 'light' with html class '', light->dark->reload persists 'dark' with html class 'dark'. REGRESSION: /login has 0 demo buttons and normal email+password login redirects to /app/dashboard.

critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.js is now correct: `if (showQr) return (...)` sits above `if (items.length === 0) return null;` and the empty-cart redirect lives in a useEffect keyed on [items.length, showQr, navigate] - no render-phase navigation.

Dark mode still relies on ~20 `.dark .<utility> { !important }` overrides in index.css instead of Tailwind dark: variants. The specific gaps are fixed (--primary-foreground now 0 0% 100%, plus bg-brand-50/50, text-brand-700, text-danger, bg-danger/10), but any newly introduced utility class will need a manual override again. Recommend migrating to dark: variants or CSS tokens before adding more pages.

`.dark .text-forest { color:#57b487 !important }` is still global; it currently does not hurt CTAs because primary buttons resolve text from --primary-foreground, but a future dark-filled button that uses text-forest for its label would regress. Scope this override to non-button contexts.
